To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the conductance of a Fe/MgO(001)/Fe(001) junction is dominated by the lowest transversal modes; (2) the conductance is strongly influenced by the barrier thickness and the MgO layer; (3) the conductance decreases when the barrier thickness decreases; (4) the conductance increases with the MgO barrier thickness; (5) the conductance oscillates as the Fe/Mg interface is displaced from the MgO layer.

the tunneling conductance of Fe/MgO /Fe junctions depends strongly on the number of channels, and that the number of channels can be increased by changing the MgO thickness and the Fe layer thickness.
the multi-channel tunneling model is able to describe the conductance of Fe/MgO hetero junctions with a realistic barrier.
In summary, our research is concerned with
multi channel transport through Fe/MgO(001)/Fe hetero junctions.
the calculation of the potential and the transport properties of Fe/MgO(001) heterojunctions.
the study of transport through realistic Fe/Mg0/Fe junctions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the multi channel tunneling model, which takes into account the effect of the barrier height and the barrier width on the tunneling probability, is able to explain quantitatively the tunneling magnetoresistance effect observed in experiments.
the multi channel transport in a Fe/MgO(1 ML)/Fe(001) junction is dominated by the first two channels.

the multi-channel transport model is in good agreement with the experimental results and that the multi-channel model provides a better description of the transport through the Fe/MG/Fe hetero-junction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the conductance is strongly dependent on the number of channels and the barrier thickness.
the multi channel tunneling model is in good agreement with experimental measurements.
our results show that the multi channel tunneling model gives a better agreement with the experimental results than the single mode approximation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the multi channel tunneling conductance of a Fe/MgO(001) heterojunction is very similar to that obtained from a one channel tunneling model.
the conductance of the hetero junction is dominated by the lowest energy channel.
multi-channel transport is important for the Fe/Mg0/Fe junction.
